Grade all student submissions in a directory or zip archive

Source: R/grade.R
grade_submissions.Rd

Expects one sub-folder per student inside submissions_path. Every student is graded on every exercise that has a test file in test_dir; a student who omits an exercise gets a missing row.

Usage

grade_submissions(
  submissions_path,
  test_dir,
  timeout = 10,
  engine = c("callr", "inproc"),
  student_name_fn = default_student_name,
  allow_masking = character(),
  workers = 1L
)

Arguments

submissions_path

Path to a directory or .zip archive of submissions.

test_dir

Directory that contains the test files.

timeout

Maximum seconds allowed per test function. Default 10.

engine

"callr" (default) or "inproc". See grade_exercise().

student_name_fn

Function applied to each student folder name to produce the display name. Defaults to taking the first underscore- separated token and applying title case. Folders that map to the same name keep their folder name, with a warning.

allow_masking

Base function names students may redefine. See grade_exercise().

workers

Number of callr subprocesses to run at the same time. Default 1. Values above 1 speed up large classes; a value near parallel::detectCores() is a good upper bound. Ignored by the "inproc" engine.

Value

A grade_results object.

Details

If submissions_path ends in .zip it is extracted into a tempdir() subfolder first. Loose files, hidden folders and __MACOSX are ignored. If the path holds a single folder with no .R files but with sub-folders, those sub-folders are taken as the students.

Examples

# One folder per student, one test file per exercise.
root <- file.path(tempdir(), "entregas")
dir.create(file.path(root, "garcia_juan"), recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(root, "lopez_maria"), recursive = TRUE)
writeLines("ceros_cuadratica <- function(a, b, c) c(-1, 1)",
           file.path(root, "garcia_juan", "ejercicio1.R"))
writeLines("ceros_cuadratica <- function(a, b, c) 0",
           file.path(root, "lopez_maria", "ejercicio1.R"))
tests <- file.path(tempdir(), "tests")
dir.create(tests)
file.copy(system.file("examples", "test_ejercicio1.R", package = "corrector"),
          tests)
#> [1] TRUE
results <- grade_submissions(root, tests)
results
#> <grade_results> 8 rows, 2 students, 1 exercises
#> Status:
#>   pass          4
#>   fail          4
as.data.frame(results, format = "wide")
#>   student ejercicio1
#> 1  Garcia      FALSE
#> 2   Lopez      FALSE
